reason: Settings is an item of the sliders-icon menu, and menu items are not Tab stops by design. From the keyboard, Enter on the sliders button opens the menu and Enter again opens the Insights Settings dialog, with focus moving into it. The failure is not reproduced.

Reproduced: in the Cashflow timeframe control Tab goes from the Runway switch to 6M and 12M and skips 3M, because the selected segment has tabindex=-1. The same component showed no-op activation and a restored tab stop on the chart-mode control in four states. I did not press Enter on 6M or 12M, since that would change a saved setting. Keyboard users lose no function.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 requires all functionality to be operable by keyboard. The only control Tab skips is the one for the value already selected (3M); re-selecting it changes nothing, and 6M and 12M are reachable and operable. 2.4.3 focus order stays logical (switch, 6M, 12M, next switch). 4.1.2 name and role are exposed (button "3M"). That the selected value is not announced is a different claim from this finding and was not evaluated here.
